content.value: The current albedo rate at top of atmosphere combined with the earth surface is approximately 0.29. If this were increased by 1.1%, what would be the amount of solar heat flux reaching on earth? Again there is currently about 1.29 W/m² heat surplus on earth. If ocean covers about 71% of the earth surface. how much excess heat in petawatts may be going into ocean and land surface. Consider ${ 1 } \mathsf { P W } = \mathsf { 1 0 } ^ { \mathsf { 1 5 } }$ W and earth radius is 6378 km.
